card.name: Linking words in risk-benefit clauses
card.fires_on: Small linking words (where, of, the, used) in drug-label sentences about patient groups, pregnancy, lactation or benefit versus risk, just before a clause about effects, benefit or potential risk.

modes.label: Linking word before benefit/risk
modes.description: A word like of, the, or because of that leads into benefit, risk or reaction wording.
